reason: B is the better proposal because it specifies a quantitatively meaningful density reduction, matched compressive-test conditions, strength-retention thresholds, and a decisive controlled experiment against the as-cast baseline. Al-induced secondary phases and loss of plasticity are serious risks, but these make the hypothesis falsifiable, whereas A lacks a quantitative density criterion, mismatches tensile testing to the likely compressive baseline, and overlooks evidence that added Zr can promote segregation and embrittlement.
